photos.title: Oceanfront condo buildings in Myrtle Beach, USGS oblique aerial photo, August 24, 2011
photos.what: A stretch of oceanfront in the City of Myrtle Beach seen from a plane over the ocean: a white high-rise tower on the left, a smaller mid-rise and a group of tan buildings with orange roofs beside it, and three long three-story buildings with white flat roofs, each pair around a pool, with parking lots between them. A road and a footpath run behind the dunes, boardwalks cross the dunes to the beach, and houses sit under oak trees behind. People on the beach are too small to recognize; no plate, sign or building name is readable.
photos.caption: Condo buildings on the ocean in Myrtle Beach, seen from a plane.
photos.alt: Oceanfront condo buildings in Myrtle Beach seen from the ocean: a white high-rise tower and three low white-roofed buildings around pools and parking lots, behind the dunes and the beach

place.sublocation: Oceanfront in the City of Myrtle Beach, north of the city center (tax district 880)

photos.provenance: U.S. government photo: USGS baseline coastal oblique aerial survey 11CCH03 (Ponte Vedra, Florida, to the South Carolina/North Carolina border), flown 2011-08-24, photographer Karen L.M. Morgan (USGS). Frame 2011_0824_180158d.jpg from https://coastal.er.usgs.gov/data-release/doi-F7N877XX/data/11CCH03_0824_180000.zip; aircraft position 33.723972 N, 78.831567 W (11CCH03-Photolocations.csv; the position of the plane, not of the buildings). The frame was taken from a copy extracted from that zip in this batch; its CRC-32 (0x4ef727f9) and size (3,728,580 bytes) match the zip's own central directory, read by HTTP range request on 2026-11-02. Data release: Morgan, K.L.M., 2017, https://doi.org/10.5066/F7N877XX. Not the frame used on any other page (others use 174830, 175156, 175537, 175948, 180052, 180133, 180143, 180608 and 181208).

photos.subject_check: Looked at full size (3008 x 1960, in four quarters) by the writer on 2026-11-02. Horry County parcels layer 24, queried 2026-11-02 over the stretch of shore landward of the plane's position, holds condo regimes in tax district 880 (City of Myrtle Beach): The Anchorage and The Anchorage II, Forest Dunes, Ocean Forest Plaza, Sandcastle, Ocean One HPR, Drayton House, Cabana I, Southwind HPR and A Place at the Beach. The caption names no building and says only 'condo buildings on the ocean in Myrtle Beach' and the year. No sign or name is legible at page size; people are specks; no plate is readable.

photos.title: Streets of houses in Carolina Forest, NOAA aerial, January 2026
photos.what: Two streets of two-story houses with gray roofs, short driveways and small back yards, several fenced, ending in a cul-de-sac, with ponds and a strip of pine woods to the left, in Carolina Forest outside city limits, seen from above on January 12, 2026. Lawns are brown in January. Cars are too small to read; no person can be recognized.
photos.caption: Houses on streets in Carolina Forest, outside city limits, seen from above.
photos.alt: Rows of two-story houses with gray roofs and short driveways along curving streets and a cul-de-sac, beside ponds and pine woods, seen from above
photos.author: NOAA National Geodetic Survey
